init.title: Options
init.description: Language of the texts from the Battle.net API, how often the integration queries it, and which groups it leaves out. Entity names follow the language of Home Assistant. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.language: "Region language" keeps the previous behaviour: German in Europe, English in the Americas, Korean in Korea, Traditional Chinese in Taiwan.
data_description.profile_minutes: Level, item level, Mythic+ rating and other profile values. Default 15. Blizzard updates the profile only after logging out.
data_description.detail_minutes: Equipment, raids, Mythic+ runs, PvP, achievements, character stats, guild activity, specialization. Default 60.
data_description.rare_minutes: Professions, collections, reputation, titles, quests, game statistics, guild and its members, images, appearance, hunter pets; also checking for new entities. Default 360 (6 hours). At least as long as Details.
data_description.disabled_groups: No queries and no entities for these groups. Existing entities keep their entity IDs and history and come back when switched on again.

error.rare_below_detail: Rare details must not be queried more often than Details.

options.classic_progression: WoW Classic Progression (currently Mists of Pandaria)

options.collections: Collections and titles (mounts, pets, toys, event New collectible)

init.title: Fix {character}
init.description:
The Battle.net API no longer finds {character}. Possible reasons: the character was renamed, moved to another realm or deleted, or has not logged in for a long time. This notice also disappears once the character is found again.

What do you want to do?

init.title: Fix {character}
init.description:
The name {character} now belongs to a different character than the one set up (the character ID at Battle.net changed). This usually happens after a rename, a realm transfer, or when a character was deleted and created again. Until you confirm, the integration shows no data for it.

Keeping the name accepts the current character; if yours was renamed, enter the new name.

Blizzard reports the profile of {character} as no longer valid. Blizzard asks not to display such data, so the integration shows nothing for this character.

If you renamed or moved it, enter the new realm or name; otherwise you can remove the character.
